title: alisma plantago-aquatica f. graminifolium
intro: Alisma plantago-aquatica f. graminifolium, commonly known as Water Plantain, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the family Alismataceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of edema, eczema, and other skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Water Plantain include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Water Plantain include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
